title: Warm Yellow Irish Masarepa Bake
description: A kid-friendly Irish dish featuring yellow masarepa, infused with herbal flavors and perfect for a spring morning. This keto-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Irish recipes.
instructions: Place 1 cup of yellow masarepa in a large bowl.
Gradually add 1 cup of boiling water to the bowl, stirring until the masarepa is well combined.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Add 4 tablespoons of melted butter, 1/4 cup of fresh parsley, 1 teaspoon of dried thyme, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper to the bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a cazuela or a 6-inch ramekin.
Place the dish in the preheated sous-vide machine and cook for 1 hour.
Remove the dish from the machine and top with 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt and 2 tablespoons of crushed bacon (if using).
